crossRefs.note: But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and…
Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of…
“Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of…
Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.
However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to Yahweh’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is…
and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to…
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
“I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and…
For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

translations.web: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
translations.bsb: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.
translations.kjv: For ➔ this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
